remarks: Welcome to this freshly painted, move-in-ready 2 bedroom/2 bath townhouse in the heart of Stamford's sought-after Glenbrook neighborhood. A bright, open floor plan features hardwood floors, a comfortable living/dining area, and a private balcony/patio perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The updated kitchen offers stainless steel appliances and abundant natural light. Upstairs, you'll find two generously sized bedrooms-including a primary with two closets and a another private balcony-along with modern bathrooms and excellent storage. This intimate complex includes a beautiful in-ground pool, well-kept common areas, a dedicated storage unit, and a reserved parking space. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, parks, and public transportation, with quick access to downtown Stamford and Metro-North for an easy NYC commute. Schedule your private showing today before it's gone!
